    ("What is Primer?", "the bond coat, especially on masonry"),
    ("State one governing principle of mural painting basics.", "Use exterior-rated paints outside."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
